name: Network Reset
description: Opens the Windows network settings page to reset adapters and restore default configurations.

description_i18n.en: Opens the Windows network settings page to reset adapters and restore default configurations.
description_i18n.de: Öffnet die Netzwerkeinstellungen, um Adapter zurückzusetzen und Standardkonfigurationen wiederherzustellen.
description_i18n.fr: Ouvre la page des paramètres réseau pour réinitialiser les adaptateurs et restaurer les configurations par défaut.

warnings.title: Network connectivity interruption
warnings.message: The network stack reset action may briefly interrupt internet connectivity while adapters are reinstalled

compatibility.notes: Designed for supported Windows desktop systems.

technical_details: Executes the network reset action by launching Windows Settings to apply default adapter states This process reverts custom DNS, proxy, and TCP/IP settings back to factory defaults
